system: NOWCAST AI — Convective Scale Weather Intelligence
disclaimer: Scientific error diagnosis library. Poor predictions and edge cases are documented to expose physical modeling limitations rather than concealed.

failure_cases.observed: Cell explosive growth from 15 dBZ to 55 dBZ in 22 minutes with severe downburst.
failure_cases.model_prediction: Delayed detection (+45 min lead time lag), underpredicted peak reflectivity by 18 dBZ.
failure_cases.root_cause: 15-minute satellite/radar sampling interval missed pre-convective boundary layer convergence pulse before radar core ascent.
failure_cases.mitigation_pathway: Incorporate AWS surface convergence tendency and Doppler radial convergence divergence flags.

failure_cases.observed: Two adjacent thunderstorm cells merged into a single bow echo structure at T+60 min.
failure_cases.model_prediction: Predicted two separate diverging trajectories; failed to model cold pool collision and merger.
failure_cases.root_cause: ConvLSTM recurrence without explicit microphysical cold pool thermodynamics struggles with non-linear cell boundary collisions.
failure_cases.mitigation_pathway: Integrate meso-scale cold pool boundary tracking and NWP low-level shear vectors.

failure_cases.event_type: C-band / X-band Doppler Radar Signal Attenuation
failure_cases.observed: Torrential rain core (>=60 dBZ) attenuated radar beam behind the first storm wall, creating artificial zero echo zone.
failure_cases.model_prediction: Forecasted false rapid dissipation of the second trailing convective cell.
failure_cases.root_cause: Radar reflectivity loss caused by path attenuation through torrential precipitation core.
failure_cases.mitigation_pathway: Multi-source sensor fusion with INSAT-3D IR brightness temperature and lightning density to override attenuated radar shadow.

failure_cases.observed: Localized extreme precipitation (>90 mm/hr) with near-zero optical lightning activity.
failure_cases.model_prediction: Severely underestimated convective risk score due to lack of lightning flash inputs.
failure_cases.root_cause: Warm-cloud collision-coalescence without deep mixed-phase graupel electrification yields negligible lightning despite intense precipitation.
failure_cases.mitigation_pathway: Decouple cloudburst alert engine from lightning threshold; prioritize orographic vertical velocity and Integrated Water Vapour (IWV).

failure_cases.event_type: DWR Coverage Gap Beyond 250 km Radar Horizon
failure_cases.observed: Active squall line entering coastal domain outside primary radar Doppler range.
failure_cases.model_prediction: Zero reflectivity input at T0 propagated low hazard until cell breached 150 km range.
failure_cases.root_cause: Radar beam elevation overshooting distant storm base and curvature of the Earth.
failure_cases.mitigation_pathway: Automatic multi-sensor fallback to rapid-scan INSAT-3DR IR / WV channels and NWP convective indices when radar mask is zero.
